system.description: Certain Baali associate too closely with spirits of corruption and plague to take pleasure from normal feeding. These vampires must instead take the cold blood of the dead, and if putrefaction has begun to set in, all the better. Cold blood is less nutritious than warm, however, and vampires with this Flaw take one fewer Blood Point's (MET: one fewer Blood Trait's) benefit than they should from feeding.
system.source: Clanbook: Baali, Chapter Three: Descent into Darkness
